envelope.description: Store the review report in the review log entry and read it back

body.title: Store the review report in the review log entry and read it back
body.summary: Add src/workflow/review/report-log.ts with reviewEntryOf (the 'review' ChangeLogEntry whose outcome.data holds { kind: 'review', report, resolutions }), resolutionEntryOf (a 'review' entry with outcome.data.kind 'review-resolution'), reviewReference (the Reference { entityId, type: 'change-log-entry', relation: 'reviews', fragment }) and readReviewReport(history, artifactId, review), which returns the report with the resolutions applied in order. Test src/workflow/review/__tests__/report-log.test.ts, including that effectiveReviewVerdict computed from the read-back report equals the verdict the old stamp gave.
acceptanceChecks: readReviewReport returns the full report from the entry the lifecycle Reference names, and undefined when the Reference or entry is absent
Later resolution entries are applied in order
effectiveReviewVerdict over the read-back report equals the verdict computed from meta.review and reviewResolutions

tests.name: report-log.test.ts: the review report and its resolutions are read back from the review entry and give the verdict the old stamp gave
